I — Put a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control. Then investigate for each creature you control.

When The Triwizard Cup enters, search your library for a creature card with mana value equal to or less then the number of Clue tokens you control, reveal it and put it onto the battlefield tapped, then shuffle.
Whenever a creature enters, it fights target creature its owner doesn't control. Then the owner of the creature that doesn't die this way creates a Treasure token.

cards.rules_text:
[i](As this Saga enters and after your draw step, add a lore counter. Exile and return this Saga to the battlefield transformed after III.)[/i]
I — Search your library for up to two land cards. Reveal and add them to your hand. Shuffle your library. If a basic land is revealed this way, you may put it onto the battlefield instead.
II — Target player creates a 3/3 green Centaur creature token. Another target player creates a 1/1 black Vampire creature token with lifelink. 
III — Create a token that is a copy of target nonhuman creature you control. Then target creature you control fights target creature you don't control.

cards.rules_text:
[i](As this Saga enters and after your draw step, add a lore counter. Exile and return this Saga to the battlefield transformed after III.)[/i]
I — Destroy target creature. It can't be regenerated. It's controller loses life equal to that creature's toughness.
II — Sagas you control have “At the beginning of each players upkeep, exile the top card of that players library. You may cast cards exiled this way without paying their mana value. If you do, you lose life equal to that cards mana value.” 
III — Until the start of your next turn, whenever one or more player loses life, that player shuffles all nonland permanents they control into their library and lose life equal to the number of permanents they shuffled this way.
